scripts.build: npm run build -w @wordparty/shared && npm run build -w @wordparty/server && npm run build -w @wordparty/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck -w @wordparty/web
